facts: DailyVNP14A1 is a maximum-class composite of750mVNP14 on1kmSIN grid, with cloud/water adjustment.
The guide assigns QA bit2 as0day/1night, opposite the linked LAADS specification. Treat the bit direction as unresolved for a V2 decoder.
The sample field is fire-only and provides no nonfire acquisition history.
